**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

**What looks good**
- Test-only: 115 files, all under `crates/*/tests/`, plus `docs/decisions/926-post-script-suites.md`. No product code, no `build.rs`/`.github`/scripts/dependency change, no snapshot PNGs, no process files (so no `PROCESS_VERSION` bump needed).
- Clean-room: the nine streams are CamCraft's own `.cnc` intermediates, each rebuilt byte for byte by a staleness guard (cl `PathBuilder`/`post::dump` in post, `motion::probing`/`motion::drilling` in app; the one hand-written stream is guarded by a parse/write round trip). Grep finds no Fusion/HSMWorks/Autodesk text in the new files.
- The suites assert something real: each case compares against either the released program or the named refusal (counted warnings or the binary's error), so a refusal that turns into a silent pass fails. Known post bugs (#994/#995/#997) are posted but not baked into goldens, and a guard fails if a listed bug has a golden, a shipped `.cps` has no suite, or the stream dir and case list disagree.
- Every new binary has a `Gate map (M4.4)` header naming the right script, `camcraft_post::post::engine`/`cnc` and the post binary (or the motion/post modules for the app guard). No new crate edge.
- Decision file present; body has `Changelog: none` and `Refs #926`.

**Local results (merged with current upstream/main, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Step | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post` lib | 16 passed |
| `recorded_streams` | 10 passed |
| 11 `script_*` suites | 9 passed each, 0 failed |
| app `recorded_post_streams` | 2 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**
- `cargo xtask gate quick --dry-run` after a one-line `assets/posts/fanuc.cps` change selects nothing on main today. The suites' headers name the script, but main's planner has no `.cps` mapping yet; that arrives with #923 (PR #967), which is still open. Not a defect here, but the selection only works once #967 merges.
- Cases listed in `KNOWN_BUGS` (8 pairs) only prove "no crash"; they gain real assertions when #994/#995/#997 are fixed and the entries removed, as the PR describes.
- `recorded/mod.rs` uses `expect`/`unwrap_or_else(panic!)`: fine in test code.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: b471395e87521c3330541ffe5889d88e253ff33d -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Merge this one before #1019.

I built and tested this PR together with #1019 (which is stacked on it) in one worktree: #1019's head `321df394` trial-merged with current `main` (`e0cb0049`, v0.18.0). The merge was clean.

### What looks good
- The suites are where the maintainer's note on #926 asks for them: `crates/post/tests/script_<stem>.rs`, one per shipped `.cps` (11). They run the post binary (`CARGO_BIN_EXE_post`) on recorded `.cnc` streams. `crates/post/Cargo.toml` adds no dependency, and nothing under `crates/post/tests` uses `camcraft_app`.
- Nine recorded streams, each a deliberate edge case shared by every post. The body and `recorded/mod.rs` say how each one was made, and each has a staleness guard:
  - `recorded_streams.rs` rebuilds the six cl-built streams byte for byte.
  - app `recorded_post_streams.rs` rebuilds the two motion-built streams. App already depends on both motion and post, so no new edge between crates.
  - The hand-written stream has a round-trip guard.
  - The guard also fails when a `.cps` has no suite or a known bug has a golden.
- The goldens pin whole programs (`.nc`) or named refusals (`.refusal`) per post and case. Known post bugs (#994, #995, #997) get no golden, so no wrong output is baked in.
- No deletions: no existing app test is lost or weakened. Slice 2 moves them, as the body says.
- Each suite header has a `Gate map` line naming its `.cps`. Making the quick gate select a suite on a `.cps` change is left to #923 / #967, as the body notes.
- `docs/decisions/926-post-script-suites.md` is present. `Refs #926` is right for a slice, and `Changelog: none` fits a test-only PR.

### Local results (merged with main, Windows)
| Suite | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-post` lib, axis_direction_cli, comp, comp_plane, mch_head_search, post_engine | ok (16 / 3 / 9 / 3 / 2 / 33) |
| `recorded_streams` | ok 10/10 |
| `script_*` x11 | ok 9/9 each |
| app `recorded_post_streams` | ok 2/2 |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app` (lib + `recorded_post_streams` and the touched post tests) `-D warnings` | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (non-blocking)
- `crates/post/tests/recorded/**` is not pinned to LF in `.gitattributes`. On a Windows checkout with `core.autocrlf=true`, the streams and goldens check out as CRLF. Your runner and guards normalise line endings (`replace("\r\n", "\n")`), so this PR is green there. #1019's `cycle_hop.rs` does not normalise, and it fails on that checkout (see that review). Adding `crates/post/tests/recorded/** text eol=lf`, like the existing `crates/app/tests/golden/**` line, would close the whole class.
- The `rotary` case uses a mirrored `.mch` until #996 lands. That is noted in the body and is fine.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
